first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The short-haired adult man on the image-left side of the first shot, wearing a black formal jacket, white shirt, and dark tie; his short hair appears dark under the dim lighting.

entities.name: Brick-and-stone wall
entities.identification: The gray masonry-block wall behind Person A and the partially plastered wall on the image-right side.

entities.name: Wooden post-and-beam frame
entities.identification: A dark wooden architectural structure, with a thick vertical post primarily visible in the first shot and stair treads, beams, posts, and a platform edge visible in the second shot.

entities.name: Reddish-brown plane at the far end
entities.identification: The reddish-brown segmented plane deep in the center of the second shot, with its surface divided by horizontal and vertical seams.

entities.name: Two hands at the bottom edge
entities.identification: The two bare hands visible at the bottom edge in the second shot, each hooking curved fingers around the same round rod.

entities.name: Central vertical shaft opening
entities.identification: The dark opening in the center of the second shot, enclosed by wooden beams and platform edges, with a boundary that appears approximately quadrilateral in perspective.

entities.name: Window opening in the wall
entities.identification: The wall opening on the image-right side of the thick vertical post in the first shot, revealing part of a thick light-colored window surround, inner wall, and windowsill.

entities.name: Foreground horizontal round rod
entities.identification: The slender brown round rod extending horizontally across the bottom of the second shot and gripped by the Two hands at the bottom edge.
